audience: SaaS founders and marketers who run an affiliate program with Rewardful

useCases.title: See how your affiliates perform
useCases.text: The AI lists affiliates with visitor, lead and conversion counts, by campaign or looked up by email, and opens one affiliate for links and coupon.

useCases.title: Find the commissions you still owe
useCases.text: The AI lists commissions by affiliate or state (pending, due, paid, voided) and adds up the amounts. It can open the sale behind one commission.

useCases.title: Check payouts and the commissions in them
useCases.text: The AI lists payouts by affiliate or state (pending, due, processing, paid) and opens one to see the commissions it bundles.

useCases.title: Trace referrals from visitor to conversion
useCases.text: The AI lists referrals filtered by affiliate, state, email or Stripe customer, with the link and conversion state of each.

useCases.title: Review, create or update campaign reward rules
useCases.text: The AI lists campaigns with commission rules, payout minimum and referral expiry. It creates a campaign or changes one.

useCases.title: Add or update an affiliate, add a link or coupon
useCases.text: The AI adds an affiliate, changes an affiliate's name, email, campaign or state, gives one an extra tracking link, or assigns a coupon code.
